layer_evidence.code: Local tests directly exercised quarantine of supplied CSS-hidden, HTML-comment, white PDF text, microtype, off-page, and hidden multipart-email content while asserting prominent quote text stayed in trusted_text. The API audit confirms quarantined spans were absent from extraction input.
layer_evidence.design: A PydanticAI TestModel inspection confirms the defended facts agent has an empty action-tool registry. Local policy tests confirm handbook parsing and deterministic rejection of an over-limit price. In the actual run, the audit records no action-tool calls; trap_calls.json remains empty.
layer_evidence.prompt: Unit tests confirm the trusted/untrusted boundary and no-action requirements are present in prompts/prompt.md. The prompt's causal contribution was not isolated in a model ablation, so no independent prompt-only success claim is made.

limitations: The baseline and defended prompts differ; relative token/cost values are observed end-to-end comparisons, not an isolated measure of one defense layer.
Prompt-cache hits occurred according to API usage; cache state affects per-run USD costs. The recorded token buckets and price-based costs are reported as returned/calculated, not adjusted.

The evidence validator requires exact verbatim quote support and can conservatively null unusual but genuine values. Hidden conflicting corrections are preserved in provenance, mark the field uncertain, and cause fail-closed decisions.
CSS and PDF visibility detection is heuristic and does not fully implement browser layout, arbitrary PDF graphics state, OCR, or all obfuscation techniques.
The prompt layer is not a hard boundary. Safety depends on parser isolation, no action tools in defended mode, evidence checks, and deterministic policy evaluation.
The handbook parser relies on the existing Markdown table headings/columns; handbook format changes require regression tests.
No action has a human-authorization path in defended mode. All email/payment requests fail closed; the tools remain inert local logging traps only in baseline mode.
